title_en: Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection
title_zh: Weasel：通过重要性–多样性数据选择实现 Web 智能体的域外泛化

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled web agents that follow natural language goals through multi-step browser interactions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）使得 Web 智能体能够通过多步浏览器交互来实现自然语言目标。

sentences.en: However, agents fine-tuned on specific trajectories and domain often struggle to generalize out of domain, and offline training can be compute-inefficient due to noisy, redundant trajectories and long accessibility-tree (AXTree) states.
sentences.zh: 然而，在特定轨迹和领域上微调的智能体往往难以实现域外泛化，并且由于存在噪声、冗余的轨迹以及较长的可访问性树（AXTree）状态，离线训练可能计算效率低下。

sentences.en: To address both issues, we propose Weasel, a trajectory selection method for offline training of web agents.
sentences.zh: 为解决这两个问题，我们提出 Weasel，一种用于 Web 智能体离线训练的轨迹选择方法。

sentences.en: Weasel selects a fixed-budget subset of trajectory steps by optimizing an objective that balances unary importance with pairwise diversity over states, websites, and interaction patterns, solving efficiently with a greedy algorithm.
sentences.zh: Weasel 通过优化一个在状态、网站与交互模式上平衡一元重要性与两两多样性的目标函数，来选择固定预算的轨迹步骤子集，并使用贪心算法高效求解。

sentences.en: We further improve efficiency with target-centered AXTree pruning that keeps only content around the ground-truth action target, and we mitigate style mismatch for reasoning-native models by replacing expert traces with model-generated, style-consistent rationales.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过以目标为中心的 AXTree 剪枝来提高效率，仅保留真实动作目标周围的内容；同时通过用模型生成的、风格一致的推理过程替换专家轨迹，来缓解推理原生模型的风格不匹配问题。

sentences.en: Across AgentTrek and NNetNav training datasets, evaluations in WebArena, WorkArena, and MiniWob, and experiments with Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, Weasel improves out-of-domain performance while reducing training cost, producing roughly 9.7-12.5$\times$ training speedups over standard fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在 AgentTrek 和 NNetNav 训练数据集上，在 WebArena、WorkArena 和 MiniWob 中的评估，以及与 Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的实验表明，Weasel 在降低训练成本的同时提升了域外性能，相对于标准微调产生了约 9.7-12.5$\times$ 的训练加速。

sentences.en: We make the code available at https://github.com/fatemehpesaran310/weasel.
sentences.zh: 我们已在 https://github.com/fatemehpesaran310/weasel 提供代码。

title_en: WeatherSyn: An Instruction Tuning MLLM For Weather Forecasting Report Generation
title_zh: WeatherSyn：用于天气预报报告生成的指令微调多模态大语言模型

sentences.en: Accurate weather forecast reporting enables individuals and communities to better plan daily activities, agricultural operations, and transportation.
sentences.zh: 准确的天气预报报告使个人和社区能够更好地规划日常活动、农业作业和交通运输。

sentences.en: However, the current reporting process primarily relies on manual analysis of multi-source data, which often leads to information overload and reduced efficiency.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的报告流程主要依赖对多源数据的人工分析，这常常导致信息过载和效率下降。

sentences.en: With the rapid advancement of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), leveraging data-driven models to analyze and generate reports in the weather forecasting domain remains largely underexplored.
sentences.zh: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的快速发展，在天气预报领域利用数据驱动模型进行分析与报告生成在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose the Weather Forecasting Report (WFR) task and construct the first instruction-tuning dataset for this task, named WSInstruct, which covers 31 cities in America and 8 weather aspects.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出天气预报报告（WFR）任务，并构建了首个针对该任务的指令微调数据集 WSInstruct，该数据集覆盖美国 31 个城市和 8 个天气维度。

sentences.en: Based on this corpus, we develop the first model, WeatherSyn, specialized in generating weather forecast reports.
sentences.zh: 基于这一语料，我们开发了首个专用于生成天气预报报告的模型 WeatherSyn。

sentences.en: Evaluation across multiple metrics on our dataset shows that WeatherSyn consistently outperforms leading closed-source MLLMs, particularly on structurally complex weather aspects.
sentences.zh: 在我们数据集上跨多个指标的评估表明，WeatherSyn 持续优于领先的闭源 MLLM，尤其是在结构复杂的天气维度上。

sentences.en: We further analyze its performance across diverse geographic regions and weather aspects.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步分析了它在不同地理区域和天气维度上的性能。

sentences.en: WeatherSyn demonstrates strong transferability across different regions, highlighting its zero-shot generalization capability.
sentences.zh: WeatherSyn 在不同区域之间表现出强大的迁移能力，凸显了其零样本泛化能力。

sentences.en: WeatherSyn offers valuable insight for developing MLLMs specialized in weather report generation.
sentences.zh: WeatherSyn 为开发专用于天气报告生成的 MLLM 提供了宝贵的见解。

title_en: Weaving Graph over Tokens: Contextualizing Structured Sequences for LLMs
title_zh: 在词元上编织图：为 LLM 语境化结构化序列

sentences.en: Generative Graph Language Models (GLMs) must reconcile topology with causal   language modeling.
sentences.zh: 生成式图语言模型（GLM）必须调和拓扑结构与因果语言建模之间的关系。

sentences.en: Linearization obscures multi-hop connectivity, while   encoder-based methods bottleneck token-level reasoning during generation.
sentences.zh: 线性化会模糊多跳连通性，而基于编码器的方法则在生成过程中对词元级推理造成瓶颈。

sentences.en: Viewing context modeling as a form of message passing, we   introduce **Weaver**, an encoder-free framework that extends the attention mechanism of decoder-only LLMs to enable graph reasoning.
sentences.zh: 将上下文建模视为一种消息传递形式，我们提出 **Weaver**，这是一个无编码器框架，它扩展了解码器专用 LLM 的注意力机制以实现图推理。

sentences.en: Weaver   maps graph distances into rotary positional embeddings so that structurally   connected nodes become proximate in attention space, propagating information   over graph topology as if it were sequential context.
sentences.zh: Weaver 将图距离映射到旋转位置嵌入中，使得结构上相连的节点在注意力空间中彼此靠近，从而像处理顺序上下文一样在图上传播信息。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we   combine: 1) a masking mechanism for causal tokens with graph structures;
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，我们结合了：1) 一种针对因果词元与图结构的掩码机制；

sentences.en: 2) a   unified geometric encoding that couples sequential position and graph distance   in joint rotary embeddings (Graph-over-Tokens RoPE); and 3) a design principle   to prioritize local information to resolve positional ambiguity under graph   symmetries.
sentences.zh: 2) 一种统一的几何编码，在联合旋转嵌入（Graph-over-Tokens RoPE）中耦合序列位置与图距离；以及 3) 一种优先考虑局部信息以解决图对称性下位置歧义的设计原则。

sentences.en: On zero-shot benchmarks, Weaver achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative GLMs, with gains of up to 30\% over prior generative methods on  heterophilic graphs, while matching specialized discriminative models on  citation networks---all within a unified decoder-only framework.
sentences.zh: 在零样本基准测试中，Weaver 在生成式 GLM 中取得了最先进的性能，在同配性（heterophilic）图上比先前的生成式方法提升高达 30\%，同时在引文网络上与专门的判别式模型持平——这一切都在统一的仅解码器框架内实现。

title_en: Weaving in the Clouds: Achieving Synergistic Collaboration among LLM Agents via Federated Learning
title_zh: 云端编织：通过联邦学习实现 LLM 智能体之间的协同合作

sentences.en: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a promising paradigm for solving workflow-structured tasks through expert collaboration.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为通过专家协作解决工作流结构化任务的一种有前景的范式。

sentences.en: However, the data required for such collaboration are often distributed across organizations and cannot be centrally pooled due to privacy, intellectual property, and compliance constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而，此类协作所需的数据通常分布在各个组织之间，由于隐私、知识产权和合规约束，无法集中汇合。

sentences.en: Federated Learning preserves data locality, but existing federated paradigms typically treat clients as independent and fail to model workflow dependencies that are crucial for coherent multi-stage collaboration.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习保留了数据本地性，但现有的联邦范式通常将客户端视为彼此独立，未能建模对连贯的多阶段协作至关重要的工作流依赖关系。

sentences.en: We introduce **FedWave**, a federated and workflow-aware framework that enables LLM-based experts to solve sequential tasks under data-locality constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **FedWave**，这是一个联邦式且感知工作流的框架，使基于 LLM 的专家能够在数据本地性约束下解决顺序任务。

sentences.en: FedWave combines a *Value Chain Layer* to model inter-stage dependencies, federated LoRA adaptation to preserve role-specific expertise, a shared *Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)* router for input-conditioned expert fusion, and a *Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)* stage based on router-induced preferences.
sentences.zh: FedWave 结合了一个*价值链层*来建模阶段间依赖关系、联邦 LoRA 适配以保留角色特定的专长、一个共享的*专家混合（MoE）*路由以根据输入条件进行专家融合，以及一个基于路由诱导偏好的*直接偏好优化（DPO）*阶段。

sentences.en: Experiments across workflow datasets and LLM backbones show that FedWave outperforms federated baselines and remains competitive with centralized multi-agent systems while preserving data locality.
sentences.zh: 跨工作流数据集和 LLM 骨干网络的实验表明，FedWave 优于联邦基线，并在保持数据本地性的同时与集中式多智能体系统保持竞争力。

title_en: WebWorld: A Large-Scale World Model for Web Agent Training
title_zh: WebWorld：用于 Web 智能体训练的大规模世界模型

sentences.en: Web agents require massive trajectories to generalize, yet real-world training is constrained by network latency, rate limits, and safety risks.
sentences.zh: Web 智能体需要海量轨迹才能实现泛化，然而真实世界的训练受到网络延迟、速率限制和安全风险的制约。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{WebWorld} series, the first open-web simulator trained at scale.
sentences.zh: 我们介绍 \textbf{WebWorld} 系列，这是首个在大规模上训练的开源 Web 模拟器。

sentences.en: While existing simulators are restricted to closed environments with thousands of trajectories, WebWorld leverages a scalable data pipeline to train on 1M+ open-web interactions, supporting reasoning, multi-format data, and long-horizon simulations of 30+ steps.
sentences.zh: 现有模拟器局限于包含数千条轨迹的封闭环境，而 WebWorld 利用可扩展的数据流水线，在超过 100 万条开放 Web 交互数据上进行训练，支持推理、多格式数据和 30 步以上的长时程模拟。

sentences.en: For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce WebWorld-Bench with dual metrics spanning nine dimensions, where WebWorld achieves simulation performance comparable to Gemini-3-Pro.
sentences.zh: 在内在评估方面，我们提出 WebWorld-Bench，采用跨越九个维度的双重指标；在此基准上，WebWorld 取得了与 Gemini-3-Pro 相当的模拟性能。

sentences.en: For extrinsic evaluation, Qwen3-14B trained on WebWorld-synthesized trajectories improves by +9.2\% on WebArena, reaching performance comparable to GPT-4o.
sentences.zh: 在外在评估方面，在 WebWorld 合成的轨迹上训练的 Qwen3-14B 在 WebArena 上提升了 +9.2\%，达到了与 GPT-4o 相当的性能。

sentences.en: WebWorld enables effective inference-time search, outperforming GPT-5 as a world model.
sentences.zh: WebWorld 实现了有效的推理时搜索，作为世界模型其性能超过了 GPT-5。

sentences.en: Beyond web simulation, WebWorld exhibits cross-domain generalization to code, GUI, and game environments, providing a replicable recipe for world-model construction.
sentences.zh: 除了 Web 模拟之外，WebWorld 还展现出对代码、GUI 和游戏环境的跨域泛化能力，为世界模型的构建提供了可复现的方案。

title_en: WeDLM: Reconciling Diffusion Language Models with Standard Causal Attention for Fast Inference
title_zh: WeDLM：将扩散语言模型与标准因果注意力相协调以实现快速推理

sentences.en: Autoregressive (AR) generation is the standard decoding paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs), but its token-by-token nature limits parallelism at inference time.
sentences.zh: 自回归（AR）生成是大语言模型（LLM）的标准解码范式，但其逐词元生成的特性限制了推理时的并行性。

sentences.en: Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) offer parallel decoding by recovering multiple masked tokens per step; however, in practice they often fail to translate this parallelism into speed gains over optimized AR engines (e.g., vLLM).
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（DLLM）通过在每一步恢复多个被掩码的词元来提供并行解码；然而在实践中，它们往往无法将这种并行性转化为相较于优化后的 AR 引擎（如 vLLM）的速度优势。

sentences.en: A key reason is that many DLLMs rely on bidirectional attention, which breaks standard prefix KV caching.
sentences.zh: 一个关键原因在于，许多 DLLM 依赖双向注意力，这破坏了标准的前缀 KV 缓存。

sentences.en: We propose WeDLM, a diffusion decoding framework built entirely on standard causal attention to make parallel generation prefix-cache friendly.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 WeDLM，这是一个完全建立在标准因果注意力之上的扩散解码框架，旨在使并行生成对前缀缓存友好。

sentences.en: The core idea is to let each masked position condition on all observed tokens while keeping a causal mask, achieved by Topological Reordering that moves observed tokens to the physical prefix while preserving their logical positions.
sentences.zh: 其核心思想是让每个被掩码的位置在保持因果掩码的同时，以所有已观测词元为条件；这通过拓扑重排序（Topological Reordering）实现，该排序在保留已观测词元逻辑位置的同时将其移动到物理前缀。

sentences.en: Building on this, we introduce a streaming decoding procedure that continuously commits confident tokens into a growing left-to-right prefix, avoiding the stop-and-wait behavior common in block diffusion methods.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们引入一种流式解码过程，不断将高置信度词元提交到不断增长的从左到右前缀中，从而避免块扩散方法中常见的停止–等待行为。

sentences.en: Experiments show that WeDLM preserves the quality of strong AR backbones while delivering substantial speedups, approaching 3× on challenging reasoning benchmarks and up to 10× in low-entropy generation regimes; critically, our comparisons are against AR baselines served by vLLM under matched deployment settings.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，WeDLM 在保持强大 AR 骨干网络质量的同时实现了大幅加速：在具有挑战性的推理基准上接近 3×，在低熵生成场景中最高可达 10×；关键是，我们的对比对象是在匹配的部署设置下由 vLLM 服务的 AR 基线。

title_en: Weight Decay Improves Language Model Plasticity
title_zh: 权重衰减提升语言模型可塑性

sentences.en: Large language models are typically trained in two broad phases: pretraining to produce a base model, followed by further training to improve downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型通常在两个大阶段中进行训练：预训练以生成基础模型，随后进行进一步训练以提升下游性能。

sentences.en: However, hyperparameter optimization and scaling laws are studied primarily from the perspective of the base model's validation loss, overlooking a crucial model property: downstream adaptability.
sentences.zh: 然而，超参数优化和缩放律主要从基础模型验证损失的角度进行研究，从而忽视了一个关键的模型属性：下游适应性。

sentences.en: In this work, we study pretraining from the perspective of *model plasticity*, that is, the ability of the base model to successfully adapt to downstream tasks upon additional training.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从*模型可塑性*的角度研究预训练，即基础模型在额外训练后成功适应下游任务的能力。

sentences.en: We focus on the role of weight decay, a key regularization parameter during pretraining, and show through systematic experiments that larger weight decay increases the plasticity of the pretrained model, resulting in greater performance gains downstream after fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于权重衰减这一预训练期间的关键正则化参数的作用，并通过系统性实验表明，更大的权重衰减会提升预训练模型的可塑性，从而在微调后带来更大的下游性能提升。

sentences.en: This effect can lead to counterintuitive trade-offs where base models that perform worse after pretraining can perform better after further training.
sentences.zh: 这一效应可能导致反直觉的权衡：预训练后表现较差的基础模型，在进一步训练后反而可以表现得更好。

sentences.en: Further investigation of weight decay's mechanistic effects on model behavior reveals that it encourages linearly separable representations, regularizes attention matrices, and reduces overfitting on the training data.
sentences.zh: 对权重衰减作用于模型行为的机制进行进一步探究后发现，它会促进线性可分的表示、正则化注意力矩阵，并减少对训练数据的过拟合。

sentences.en: Together, these findings highlight the importance of pretrained model plasticity, the limits of using cross-entropy loss as the sole metric for hyperparameter optimization, and the multifaceted role that a single optimization hyperparameter plays in shaping model behavior.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些发现凸显了预训练模型可塑性的重要性、将交叉熵损失作为超参数优化唯一指标的局限性，以及单一优化超参数在塑造模型行为方面所扮演的多方面角色。

title_en: Weight Updates as Activation Shifts: A Principled Framework for Steering
title_zh: 将权重更新视为激活偏移：一个原则化的引导框架

sentences.en: Activation steering promises to be an extremely parameter-efficient form of adaptation, but its effectiveness depends on critical design choices---such as intervention location and parameterization---that currently rely on empirical heuristics rather than a principled foundation.
sentences.zh: 激活引导有望成为一种极为参数高效的适配形式，但其有效性取决于关键的设计选择——例如干预位置和参数化——这些目前依赖于经验启发式而非原则化基础。

sentences.en: We establish a first-order equivalence between activation-space interventions and weight-space updates, deriving the conditions under which activation steering can replicate fine-tuning behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们在激活空间干预与权重空间更新之间建立了等价的一阶关系，并推导出激活引导能够复现微调行为的条件。

sentences.en: This equivalence yields a \textbf{principled framework for steering design} and identifies the post-block output as a theoretically-backed and highly expressive intervention site.
sentences.zh: 这一等价关系催生了一个\textbf{原则化的引导设计框架}，并将块后输出确定为具有理论支撑且表达力很强的干预位置。

sentences.en: We explain why certain intervention locations outperform others and show that weight updates and activation updates play distinct, complementary functional roles.
sentences.zh: 我们解释了为何某些干预位置优于其他位置，并表明权重更新与激活更新发挥着不同且互补的功能作用。

sentences.en: This analysis motivates a new approach---\textbf{joint adaptation}---that trains in both spaces simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 这一分析催生了一种新方法——\textbf{联合适配}——它在两个空间中同时进行训练。

sentences.en: Our post-block steering achieves accuracy within $0.2\%\text{--}0.9\%$ of full-parameter tuning, on average across tasks and models, while training only $0.04\%$ of model parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们的块后引导在任务和模型上的平均精度与全参数微调的差距在 $0.2\%\text{--}0.9\%$ 以内，而仅训练了 $0.04\%$ 的模型参数。

sentences.en: It consistently outperforms prior activation steering methods such as ReFT and PEFT approaches including LoRA, while using significantly fewer parameters.
sentences.zh: 它在一致性上优于 ReFT 等先前的激活引导方法以及包括 LoRA 在内的 PEFT 方法，同时使用的参数显著更少。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that joint adaptation often surpasses the performance ceilings of weight and activation updates in isolation, introducing a new paradigm for efficient model adaptation
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明联合适配往往超过单独使用权重更新与激活更新时的性能上限，为高效模型适配引入了一种新的范式。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Weight-Space Learning for Certifiable Few-shot Transfer Learning
title_zh: 用于可认证小样本迁移学习的权重空间学习

sentences.en: In contemporary deep learning, a prevalent and effective workflow for solving low-data problems is adapting powerful pre-trained foundation models (FMs) to new tasks via parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).
sentences.zh: 在当代深度学习中，解决低数据问题的一种普遍而有效的工作流程是，通过参数高效微调（PEFT）将强大的预训练基础模型（FM）适配到新任务上。

sentences.en: However, while empirically effective, the resulting solutions lack generalisation guarantees to certify their accuracy - which may be required for ethical or legal reasons prior to deployment in high-importance applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管其经验上有效，所得解决方案却缺乏认证其准确性的泛化保证——在部署到高重要性应用之前，出于伦理或法律原因这可能是必需的。

sentences.en: In this paper we develop a novel transfer learning approach that is designed to facilitate non-vacuous learning theoretic generalisation guarantees for downstream tasks, even in the low-shot regime.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们开发了一种新颖的迁移学习方法，旨在为下游任务提供非平凡的（non-vacuous）学习理论泛化保证，即使在低样本场景下也是如此。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first use upstream tasks to train a {\em distribution over PEFT parameters}.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先利用上游任务训练一个 {\em PEFT 参数上的分布}。

sentences.en: We then learn the downstream task by a {\em sample-and-evaluate} procedure -- sampling plausible PEFTs from the trained diffusion model and selecting the one with the highest likelihood on the downstream data.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们通过 {\em 采样–评估} 过程学习下游任务——从训练好的扩散模型中采样合理的 PEFT，并选择在下游数据上似然最高的那个。

sentences.en: Crucially, this confines our model hypothesis to a {\em finite} set of PEFT samples.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，这使我们的模型假设被限制在一个 {\em 有限} 的 PEFT 样本集合内。

sentences.en: In contrast to the typical continuous hypothesis spaces of neural network weights, this facilitates tighter risk certificates.
sentences.zh: 与神经网络权重通常的连续假设空间相比，这有助于获得更紧致的风险证书。

sentences.en: We instantiate our bound and show non-trivial generalization guarantees compared to existing learning approaches which lead to vacuous bounds in the low-shot regime.
sentences.zh: 我们对这一界限进行了具体化，并展示了相较于现有学习方法更强的非平凡泛化保证，而这些现有方法在低样本场景下往往导致空洞的界限。

authors.institution: University of Cambridge & Samsung AI Center, Cambridge

authors.name: Timothy Hospedales
authors.institution: Samsung AI Centre / University of Edinburgh

title_en: Weight-sparse transformers have interpretable circuits
title_zh: 权重稀疏 Transformer 具有可解释的回路

sentences.en: Finding human-understandable circuits in language models is a central goal of the field of mechanistic interpretability.
sentences.zh: 在语言模型中发现人类可理解的回路，是机制可解释性领域的核心目标。

sentences.en: We train models to have more understandable circuits by constraining most of their weights to be zeros, so that each neuron only has a few connections.
sentences.zh: 我们将模型的大部分权重约束为零进行训练，使模型具有更易理解的回路，从而使每个神经元只保留少数几条连接。

sentences.en: To recover fine-grained circuits underlying each of several hand-crafted tasks, we prune the models to isolate the part responsible for the task.
sentences.zh: 为恢复支撑若干手工构造任务中每一个任务的细粒度回路，我们对模型进行剪枝，以隔离负责该任务的部分。

sentences.en: These circuits often contain neurons and residual channels that correspond to natural concepts, with a small number of straightforwardly interpretable connections between them.
sentences.zh: 这些回路通常包含与自然概念相对应的神经元和残差通道，它们之间只有少数几条直接可解释的连接。

sentences.en: We study how these models scale and find that making weights sparser trades off capability for interpretability, and scaling model size improves the capability-interpretability frontier.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了这些模型的扩展规律，发现使权重更稀疏会在能力与可解释性之间进行权衡，而扩大模型规模会改善能力–可解释性的前沿。

sentences.en: However, scaling sparse models beyond tens of millions of nonzero parameters while preserving interpretability remains a challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，在保持可解释性的同时，将稀疏模型扩展到数千万个非零参数以上仍然是一个挑战。

sentences.en: In addition to training weight-sparse models de novo, we show preliminary results suggesting our method can also be adapted to explain existing dense models.
sentences.zh: 除了从头训练权重稀疏模型之外，我们还展示了初步结果，表明我们的方法也可以被改造用于解释现有的稠密模型。

sentences.en: Our work produces circuits that achieve an unprecedented level of human understandability and validates them with considerable rigor.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作生成了达到空前人类可理解程度的回路，并对其进行了相当严格的验证。

title_en: WeightCLIP: Aligning Datasets and Models for Weight Space Learning
title_zh: WeightCLIP：为权重空间学习对齐数据集与模型

sentences.en: Weight space learning aims to learn representations of neural network (NN) weights, enabling different downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 权重空间学习旨在学习神经网络（NN）权重的表示，从而支持不同的下游任务。

sentences.en: Existing approaches show promising performance, but lacking a way to shape these weight-space representations using information about the datasets the models were trained on, thus limiting downstream applications.
sentences.zh: 现有方法表现出有前景的性能，但缺乏一种利用模型所训练数据集的信息来塑造这些权重空间表示的方式，从而限制了下游应用。

sentences.en: We propose **WeightCLIP**, a method for learning a dataset-aligned latent space for neural networks, where datasets information is induced during training.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **WeightCLIP**，一种用于学习与数据集对齐的神经网络潜在空间的方法，其中数据集信息在训练期间被引入。

sentences.en: The NNs are encoded as latent representations using an autoencoder, while dataset samples are encoded using a dataset encoder.
sentences.zh: 神经网络通过自编码器被编码为潜在表示，而数据集样本则使用数据集编码器进行编码。

sentences.en: The two representations are aligned using a contrastive objective, effectively reshaping the weight-space representations according to the datasets.
sentences.zh: 这两种表示通过对比目标进行对齐，从而根据数据集有效地重塑权重空间表示。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that such representations can be used for different downstream tasks, including mapping dataset information to a weight-space representation that decode to strong models.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了此类表示可用于不同的下游任务，包括将数据集信息映射为能够解码出强大模型的权重空间表示。

sentences.en: In addition, we introduce a latent refinement process for generating models that outperforms standard fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一种潜在精化过程来生成模型，其表现优于标准微调。

sentences.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that explicitly incorporating dataset information improves what can be achieved with weight-space representations across retrieval, generation, and refinement.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，显式纳入数据集信息能够提升在检索、生成和精化等任务中权重空间表示所能达到的性能。

sentences.en: Code will be available at https://github.com/HSG-AIML/WeightCLIP.
sentences.zh: 代码将在 https://github.com/HSG-AIML/WeightCLIP 发布。

title_en: Weights to Code: Extracting Interpretable Algorithms from the Discrete Transformer
title_zh: 从权重到代码：从离散 Transformer 中提取可解释算法

sentences.en: Algorithm extraction aims to synthesize executable programs directly from models trained on algorithmic tasks, enabling *de novo* recovery of executable mechanisms from weights without relying on human-written target programs.
sentences.zh: 算法提取旨在直接从在算法任务上训练的模型中合成可执行程序，从而无需依赖人工编写的目标程序，即可从权重中*从头（de novo）*恢复可执行的机制。

sentences.en: However, applying this paradigm to Transformer is complicated by representation entanglement (e.g., superposition), where features encoded in overlapping directions substantially hinder the recovery of symbolic expressions.
sentences.zh: 然而，将这一范式应用于 Transformer 会因表示纠缠（例如叠加）而变得复杂，其中编码在重叠方向上的特征会严重阻碍符号表达式的恢复。

sentences.en: We propose the Discrete Transformer, an architecture explicitly designed to bridge the gap between continuous representations and discrete symbolic logic.
sentences.zh: 我们提出离散 Transformer（Discrete Transformer），这是一种专门设计用于弥合连续表示与离散符号逻辑之间鸿沟的架构。

sentences.en: By injecting discreteness through temperature-annealed sampling, our framework effectively leverages hypothesis testing and symbolic regression to extract human-readable programs.
sentences.zh: 通过温度退火采样注入离散性，我们的框架有效地利用假设检验和符号回归来提取人类可读的程序。

sentences.en: Empirically, the Discrete Transformer achieves performance comparable to the RNN-based MIPS baseline on shared discrete tasks, while broadening extraction to tasks with continuous-valued intermediate computations.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，离散 Transformer 在共有的离散任务上取得了与基于 RNN 的 MIPS 基线相当的性能，同时将提取扩展到具有连续值中间计算的任务。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that architectural inductive biases provide fine-grained control over synthesized programs, establishing the Discrete Transformer as a controllable testbed for algorithm extraction and Transformer interpretability.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明架构归纳偏置能够对合成程序进行细粒度控制，从而将离散 Transformer 确立为算法提取与 Transformer 可解释性的可控测试平台。

title_en: Welfare-Optimal Classification with Accuracy Auctions
title_zh: 基于精度拍卖的福利最优分类

sentences.en: Prediction algorithms are increasingly used to inform decisions about humans, but maximizing accuracy—the standard learning objective—is not necessarily optimal for this purpose.
sentences.zh: 预测算法越来越多地被用于为关于人的决策提供依据，但最大化精度——这一标准学习目标——对于这一目的而言并不一定是最优的。

sentences.en: Instead, we propose optimizing social welfare, defined as the average gain users receive from correct predictions.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们提出优化社会福利，它被定义为用户从正确预测中获得的平均收益。

sentences.en: Welfare enables to express, and therefore account for, heterogeneity in how much users benefit from accuracy.
sentences.zh: 福利能够表达并因此考虑用户在受益于精度程度上的异质性。

sentences.en: But since these valuations are private and users can benefit from overreporting them, learning must simultaneously elicit truthful values and optimize welfare with respect to them.
sentences.zh: 但由于这些估值是私密的，且用户可能通过虚报它们而获益，因此学习过程必须同时诱导真实的估值，并据此优化福利。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose a novel learning algorithm that incorporates a truthful auction.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出一种新颖的学习算法，其中融入了真实报告拍卖机制。

sentences.en: We show how to compute allocations and prices efficiently, and bound the number of paying users—which surprisingly is independent of the sample size.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了如何高效地计算分配与定价，并给出了付费用户数量的界限——令人惊讶的是，该界限与样本量无关。

sentences.en: We conclude with experiments on real and synthetic data that demonstrate our algorithm and explore the connections between welfare and accuracy.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在真实与合成数据上进行了实验，以展示我们的算法，并探究福利与精度之间的联系。

title_en: Well-Posed KL-Regularized Control via Wasserstein and Kalman–Wasserstein KL Divergences
title_zh: 通过 Wasserstein 与 Kalman–Wasserstein KL 散度实现适定的 KL 正则化控制

sentences.en: Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization is widely used in reinforcement learning, but it becomes infinite under support mismatch and can degenerate in low-noise regimes.
sentences.zh: Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度正则化在强化学习中被广泛使用，但在支撑不匹配的情况下会变为无穷大，并且在低噪声场景下可能发生退化。

sentences.en: Using a unified information-geometric framework, we introduce KL analogs by replacing the Fisher–Rao geometry in the dynamical formulation of the KL with transport-based geometries, and derive closed-form expressions for common distribution families.
sentences.zh: 利用统一的信息几何框架，我们用基于传输的几何替换 KL 动力学表述中的 Fisher–Rao 几何，从而引入 KL 的类似物，并为常见的分布族推导出闭式表达式。

sentences.en: Between elliptic distributions, these divergences remain finite for degenerating equal covariances and yield a geometric interpretation of regularization heuristics used in Kalman ensemble methods.
sentences.zh: 在椭圆分布之间，对于退化的相等协方差，这些散度仍然保持有限，并为 Kalman 集成方法中使用的正则化启发式方法提供了几何解释。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the utility of these divergences in KL-regularized optimal control.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了这些散度在 KL 正则化最优控制中的效用。

sentences.en: In the fully tractable setting of linear time-invariant systems with Gaussian process noise, the classical KL reduces to a quadratic control penalty that becomes singular as process noise vanishes.
sentences.zh: 在具有高斯过程噪声的线性时不变系统的完全可解设置中，经典 KL 退化为一项二次控制惩罚，随着过程噪声消失而变得奇异。

sentences.en: Our variants remove this singularity and yield well-posed problems.
sentences.zh: 我们的变体消除了这一奇异性，从而产生适定的问题。

sentences.en: On a double integrator and a cart-pole example, the resulting controls preserve nontrivial feedback and achieve better closed-loop performance.
sentences.zh: 在双积分器和倒立摆（cart-pole）示例上，所得的控制器保持了非平凡的反馈，并实现了更好的闭环性能。

title_en: WestWorld: A Knowledge-Encoded Scalable Trajectory World Model for Diverse Robotic Systems
title_zh: WestWorld：面向多样机器人系统的知识编码可扩展轨迹世界模型

sentences.en: Trajectory world models play a crucial role in robotic dynamics learning, planning, and control.
sentences.zh: 轨迹世界模型在机器人动力学学习、规划和控制中发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: While recent works have explored trajectory world models for diverse robotic systems, they struggle to scale to a large number of distinct system dynamics and overlook domain knowledge of physical structures.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期工作已经探索了面向多样机器人系统的轨迹世界模型，但它们难以扩展到大量不同的系统动力学，并且忽略了物理结构方面的领域知识。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce *WestWorld*, a kno**W**ledge-**E**ncoded **S**calable **T**rajectory **World** model for diverse robotic systems.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们引入了 *WestWorld*，一个面向多样机器人系统的知识编码可扩展轨迹世界模型。

sentences.en: To tackle the scalability challenge, we propose a novel system-aware Mixture-of-Experts (Sys-MoE) that dynamically combines and routes specialized experts for different robotic systems via a learnable system embedding.
sentences.zh: 为应对可扩展性挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的面向系统的专家混合（Sys-MoE）机制，它通过可学习的系统嵌入，动态地组合并路由面向不同机器人系统的专用专家。

sentences.en: To further enhance zero-shot generalization, we incorporate domain knowledge of robot physical structures by introducing a structural embedding that aligns trajectory representations with morphological information.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步增强零样本泛化，我们通过引入一种结构嵌入（structural embedding）来融入机器人物理结构的领域知识，该嵌入将轨迹表示与形态学信息对齐。

sentences.en: After pretraining on 89 complex environments spanning diverse morphologies across both simulation and real-world settings, *WestWorld* achieves significant improvements over competitive baselines in zero- and few-shot trajectory prediction.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖仿真和真实环境中各种形态的 89 个复杂环境上进行预训练后，*WestWorld* 在零样本和少样本轨迹预测中相比有竞争力的基线取得了显著改进。

sentences.en: Additionally, it shows strong scalability across a wide range of robotic environments and significantly improves performance on downstream model-based control for different robots.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在一系列广泛的机器人环境中表现出强大的可扩展性，并显著提升了不同机器人的下游基于模型控制性能。

sentences.en: Finally, we deploy our model on a real-world Unitree Go1, where it demonstrates stable locomotion performance ([see our demo on the website](https://westworldrobot.github.io/)).
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将模型部署在真实的 Unitree Go1 上，它展现出稳定的运动性能（[请在我们的网站上查看演示](https://westworldrobot.github.io/)）。

authors.name: Tianyi Zhou
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

title_en: WET: Mitigating World-Conditioned Knowledge Conflicts via World Entropy Tethering
title_zh: WET：通过世界熵系栓缓解世界条件化知识冲突

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) face a "loyalty dilemma" when correctness is conditioned on an active world-of-discourse.
sentences.zh: 当正确性依赖于一个活跃的话语世界（world-of-discourse）时，大语言模型（LLM）会面临一种“忠诚困境”。

sentences.en: We identify a systemic failure mode---world misattribution---where models implicitly ground generation in an incompatible regime and drift from the target world.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一种系统性的失败模式——世界误归属（world misattribution）——即模型隐式地将生成建立在不兼容的机制之上，并偏离目标世界。

sentences.en: We propose World Entropy Tethering (WET), an inference-time monitor-and-tether: a world-entropy probe flags drift risk on prompt anchors, and a conditional score matching geometry model identifies tethering heads for entropy-gated rescaling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了世界熵系栓（WET），一种推理时的监测-系栓机制：一个世界熵探针在提示锚点上标记漂移风险，一个基于条件分数匹配的几何模型识别用于熵门控重缩放的系栓头（tethering heads）。

sentences.en: Experiments show: (I) Linear Separability: world labels are linearly decodable from internal states;
sentences.zh: 实验表明：(I) 线性可分性：世界标签可以从内部状态线性解码；

sentences.en: (II) Geometric Drift: hallucinations are preceded by measurable deviations from the target world region; and (III) Targeted Mitigation: WET improves world consistency and reduces hallucination rates by up to 22.4% without compromising generation quality.
sentences.zh: (II) 几何漂移：幻觉之前伴随着可测量的、偏离目标世界区域的偏差；以及 (III) 针对性缓解：WET 在不损害生成质量的前提下，将世界一致性提升最多 22.4%，并减少幻觉。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/guess-guess-who-i-am/WET-World-Entropy-Tethering.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/guess-guess-who-i-am/WET-World-Entropy-Tethering 获取。

title_en: WEVSR: Video Diffusion Generators for Real-World Video Super‑Resolution with Wavelet-Enhanced VAE Encoder
title_zh: WEVSR：面向真实世界视频超分辨率的视频扩散生成器与增强小波 VAE 编码器

sentences.en: Recent advances in video diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable generative capability, yet adapting these large pretrained  text-to-video (T2V) models to video super‑resolution (VSR) typically encounters challenges, such as artifacts introduced by complex degradations in real-world scenarios and compromised fidelity due to the strong generative capacity of the powerful T2V models.
sentences.zh: 视频扩散模型的最新进展展现了非凡的生成能力，然而将这些大型预训练的文生视频（T2V）模型适配到视频超分辨率（VSR）通常会遇到挑战，例如真实场景中复杂退化引入的伪影，以及强大的 T2V 模型的强生成能力所带来的保真度受损。

sentences.en: We present WEVSR, a novel approach that adapts a pretrained flow-matching video diffusion transformer to VSR.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 WEVSR，一种将预训练的流匹配视频扩散 Transformer 适配到 VSR 的新颖方法。

sentences.en: First, we design a task-oriented adaptation strategy that leverages timestep sampling and noise augmentation to enhance detail restoration while preserving structural stability.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们设计了一种面向任务的适配策略，利用时间步采样和噪声增强来提升细节恢复，同时保持结构稳定性。

sentences.en: Second, we propose a lightweight multi-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) front-end for the VAE encoder, injecting explicit frequency priors into the latent space without modifying the pretrained decoder.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们为 VAE 编码器提出了一个轻量级的多级离散小波变换（DWT）前端，在无需修改预训练解码器的情况下将显式的频率先验注入潜在空间。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple VSR benchmarks demonstrate that WEVSR achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 在多个 VSR 基准上的大量实验表明，WEVSR 相比现有方法达到了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Code and models will be released here.
sentences.zh: 代码和模型将在这里发布。

title_en: WF-Bench: A Benchmark for Neural-Network WaveFunction Expressivity and Scaling Laws
title_zh: WF-Bench：神经网络波函数表达力与缩放律基准

sentences.en: We present a comprehensive benchmarking dataset and empirical scaling law analysis for neural network wavefunctions by matching them to a wide spectrum of famous many body target wavefunctions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将神经网络波函数与多种著名的多体目标波函数进行匹配，为神经网络波函数提供了一个全面的基准数据集和实证缩放律分析。

sentences.en: The dataset, WF-Bench, spans multiple distinct regimes of strongly correlated quantum matter, including topological states, Wigner crystals, and superconducting wavefunctions, providing a diverse and challenging test bed for neural network wavefunction expressivity.
sentences.zh: 该数据集 WF-Bench 涵盖了强关联量子物质的多个不同领域，包括拓扑态、Wigner 晶体和超导波函数，为神经网络波函数的表达力提供了多样且具有挑战性的测试平台。

sentences.en: We introduce a systematic and reproducible benchmarking protocol for target wavefunction matching, enabling consistent performance evaluation across different neural network wavefunction architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们为目标波函数匹配引入了一套系统且可复现的基准测试协议，从而能够在不同的神经网络波函数架构之间进行一致的性能评估。

sentences.en: By using wavefunction fidelity as the uniform metric, we discover empirical scaling laws that characterize how representability depends on system size and key model parameters, including number of determinant and model depth.
sentences.zh: 通过使用波函数保真度作为统一指标，我们发现了一些实证缩放律，它们刻画了可表示性如何依赖于系统规模和关键模型参数，包括行列式数量与模型深度。

sentences.en: By applying our benchmark protocol on Psiformer and Ferminet, we show that WF-Bench establishes a unified dataset driven framework for evaluating and comparing neural network wavefunctions and for guiding the design of future architectures.
sentences.zh: 通过在我们的基准协议上应用 Psiformer 和 Ferminet，我们表明 WF-Bench 建立了一个统一的数据驱动框架，用于评估和比较神经网络波函数，并指导未来架构的设计。

title_en: WFR-MFM: One-Step Inference for Dynamic Unbalanced Optimal Transport
title_zh: WFR-MFM：动态非平衡最优传输的一步推理

sentences.en: Reconstructing dynamical evolution from limited observations is a fundamental challenge in single-cell biology, where dynamic unbalanced optimal transport (OT) provides a principled framework for modeling coupled transport and mass variation.
sentences.zh: 从有限的观测中重建动态演化过程是单细胞生物学中的一个基本挑战，其中动态非平衡最优传输（OT）为建模耦合的传输与质量变化提供了一个原则化框架。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches rely on trajectory simulation at inference time, making inference a key bottleneck for scalable applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在推理时依赖轨迹模拟，这使得推理成为可扩展应用的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a mean-flow framework for unbalanced flow matching that summarizes both transport and mass-growth dynamics over arbitrary time intervals using mean velocity and mass-growth fields, enabling fast one-step generation without trajectory simulation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种用于非平衡流匹配的平均流动框架，它利用平均速度和质量增长场来概括任意时间间隔内的传输与质量增长动态，从而无需轨迹模拟即可实现快速地一步生成。

sentences.en: To solve dynamic unbalanced OT under the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao geometry, we further build on this framework to develop **Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao Mean Flow Matching (WFR-MFM)**.
sentences.zh: 为在 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao 几何下求解动态非平衡 OT，我们进一步基于该框架开发了 **Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao 平均流动匹配（WFR-MFM）**。

sentences.en: Across synthetic and real single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, WFR-MFM achieves orders-of-magnitude faster inference than a range of existing baselines while maintaining high predictive accuracy, and enables efficient perturbation response prediction on large synthetic datasets with thousands of conditions.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实的单细胞 RNA 测序数据集上，WFR-MFM 的推理速度比一系列现有基线快了数个数量级，同时保持了较高的预测精度，并且能够在包含数千种条件的大规模合成数据集上实现高效的扰动响应预测。

authors.name: Xinyu Wang
authors.institution: School of Mathematical Sciences, Peking University

title_en: What Characterizes Effective Reasoning? Revisiting Length, Review, and Structure of CoT
title_zh: 什么造就了有效推理？重新审视思维链的长度、回顾与结构

sentences.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) spend substantial test-time compute on long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, but what *characterizes* an effective CoT remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在长思维链（CoT）轨迹上消耗大量测试时计算资源，但什么样的 CoT 才算*有效*，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: While prior work reports gains from lengthening CoTs and increasing review via appended *wait* tokens, recent studies suggest that shorter thinking can outperform longer traces.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作报告称，通过加长 CoT 以及附加*等待*（wait）token 来增加回顾可以带来收益，但最近的研究表明，较短的思考可能优于较长的轨迹。

sentences.en: We therefore conduct a systematic evaluation across ten LRMs on math and scientific reasoning.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对十个 LRM 在数学与科学推理任务上进行了系统性评估。

sentences.en: Contrary to the “longer-is-better” narrative, we find that both naively using longer CoTs and more review behaviors are associated with *lower* accuracy.
sentences.zh: 与“越长越好”的说法相反，我们发现，盲目使用更长的 CoT 以及更多的回顾行为都与*更低*的准确率相关。

sentences.en: As CoT unfolds step by step, token-level metrics can conflate verbosity with process quality.
sentences.zh: 随着 CoT 逐步展开，token 级别的指标可能会将冗长与过程质量混为一谈。

sentences.en: We introduce a graph view of CoT to extract structure and identify a single statistic—the *Failed-Step Fraction* (FSF), the fraction of steps in abandoned branches—that consistently outpredicts length and review ratio for correctness across models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 CoT 的图视角来提取结构，并确定了一个单一统计量——*失败步骤占比*（Failed-Step Fraction，FSF），即被放弃分支中步骤所占的比例——它在跨模型的正确性预测中始终优于长度和回顾比例。

sentences.en: To probe causality, we design two interventions.
sentences.zh: 为了探究因果性，我们设计了两项干预实验。

sentences.en: First, we rank candidate CoTs by each metric at test time, where FSF yields the largest pass@1 gains; second, we edit CoTs to remove failed branches, which significantly improves accuracy, indicating that failed branches bias subsequent reasoning.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们在测试时根据每个指标对候选 CoT 进行排序，其中 FSF 带来了最大的 pass@1 提升；其次，我们修改 CoT 以移除失败分支，这显著提高了准确率，表明失败分支会使后续推理产生偏差。

sentences.en: Taken together, these results characterize effective CoTs as those that *fail less* and support *structure-aware* test-time scaling over indiscriminately generating long CoTs.
sentences.zh: 综上所述，这些结果将有效 CoT 的特征刻画为*失败更少*，并支持采用*结构感知*的测试时扩展，而不是不加区分地生成长 CoT。

authors.name: Anthony Hartshorn
authors.institution: University College London, University of London

title_en: What Do Agents Learn from Trajectory-SFT: Semantics or Interfaces?
title_zh: 智能体从轨迹 SFT 中学到了什么：语义还是接口？

sentences.en: Large language models are increasingly evaluated as interactive agents, yet standard agent benchmarks conflate two qualitatively distinct sources of success: semantic tool-use and interface-specific interaction pattern memorization.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被当作交互式智能体进行评估，但标准的智能体基准将两种性质截然不同的成功来源混为一谈：语义工具使用与针对特定接口的交互模式记忆。

sentences.en: Because both mechanisms can yield identical task success on the original interface, benchmark scores alone are not identifiable evidence of environment-invariant capability.
sentences.zh: 由于这两种机制在原始接口上都能产生相同的任务成功率，单靠基准分数无法作为环境无关能力的可辨识证据。

sentences.en: We propose **PIPE**, a protocol-level evaluation augmentation for diagnosing interface reliance by minimally rewriting environment interfaces while preserving task semantics and execution behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **PIPE**，一种协议级别的评估增强方法，通过最小化地改写环境接口（同时保留任务语义与执行行为）来诊断对接口的依赖。

sentences.en: Across 16 environments from AgentBench and AgentGym and a range of open-source and API-based agents, PIPE reveals that trajectory-SFT substantially amplifies interface shortcutting: trained agents degrade sharply under minimal interface rewrites, while non-trajectory-trained models remain largely stable.
sentences.zh: 在来自 AgentBench 和 AgentGym 的 16 个环境以及一系列开源和基于 API 的智能体中，PIPE 揭示出轨迹 SFT 会大幅放大接口捷径行为：经过训练的智能体在最小接口改写下表现急剧下降，而未经过轨迹训练的模型则基本保持稳定。

sentences.en: We further introduce Interface Reliance (IR), a counterbalanced alias-based metric that quantifies preference for training-time interfaces, and show that interface shortcutting exhibits environment-dependent, non-monotonic training dynamics that remain invisible under standard evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入了接口依赖度（Interface Reliance，IR），一种平衡设计的、基于别名的度量，用于量化模型对训练时接口的偏好，并表明接口捷径行为表现出依赖环境的、非单调的训练动态，而这些在标准评估下是不可见的。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/What-Do-Agents-Learn-from-Trajectory-SFT-Semantics-or-Interfaces--0831/.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/What-Do-Agents-Learn-from-Trajectory-SFT-Semantics-or-Interfaces--0831/ 获取。

title_en: What Does Flow-Matching Bring to TD-Learning?
title_zh: 流匹配为 TD 学习带来了什么？

sentences.en: Recent work shows that flow-matching networks can be effective for value function estimation in reinforcement learning, but it remains unclear why they work well or whether flow-matching Q-functions differ fundamentally from standard critics.
sentences.zh: 最近的工作表明，流匹配网络在强化学习的价值函数估计中可以很有效，但为何它们表现出色、以及流匹配 Q 函数是否与标准评论家（critic）存在本质差异，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We show that their success is not explained by distributional RL: explicitly modeling return distributions often degrades performance.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，它们的成功并不能用分布式强化学习来解释：显式地对回报分布建模往往会降低性能。

sentences.en: Instead, we argue that flow-matching Q-functions are effective because they couple a learned velocity field with an integration procedure that is used both during training and to read out Q-values at inference time.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们认为流匹配 Q 函数之所以有效，是因为它将学到的速度场与一个积分过程耦合在一起，而这一过程在训练期间以及在推理时读取 Q 值时都会用到。

sentences.en: This coupling enables robust value prediction through \emph{test-time recovery} from imperfect intermediate estimates where errors dampen out as more integration steps are performed.
sentences.zh: 这种耦合能够通过\emph{测试时恢复}（test-time recovery）实现稳健的价值预测，即从不完美的中间估计中恢复，随着积分步数的增加，误差会逐步衰减。

sentences.en: This mechanism is absent in monolithic critics.
sentences.zh: 这一机制在整体式评论家（monolithic critic）中并不存在。

sentences.en: Beyond test-time recovery, training with the integration procedure induces more \emph{plastic} representations, allowing critics to represent non-stationary future TD targets without overwriting previous features.
sentences.zh: 除了测试时恢复之外，使用积分过程进行训练还会产生更具\emph{可塑性}（plastic）的表征，使评论家能够在不覆盖先前特征的前提下表示非平稳的未来 TD 目标。

sentences.en: We formalize these effects and validate them empirically, showing that flow-matching critics outperform monolithic critics by over $2\times$ in performance and achieve $5$–$10\times$ higher sample efficiency in high-UTD regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们将这些效应形式化并在实验上进行验证，结果表明流匹配评论家在性能上超过整体式评论家 $2\times$ 以上，并在高 UTD 场景下实现了 $5$–$10\times$ 更高的样本效率。

title_en: What Does Preference Learning Recover from Pairwise Comparison Data?
title_zh: 偏好学习能从成对比较数据中恢复出什么？

sentences.en: Pairwise preference learning is central to machine learning, with recent applications in aligning language models with human preferences.
sentences.zh: 成对偏好学习是机器学习中的核心问题，最近还被应用于让语言模型与人类偏好对齐。

sentences.en: A typical dataset consists of triplets $(x, y^+, y^-)$, where response $y^+$ is preferred over response $y^-$ for context $x$.
sentences.zh: 典型的数据集由三元组 $(x, y^+, y^-)$ 组成，其中在上下文 $x$ 下，回答 $y^+$ 优于回答 $y^-$。

sentences.en: The Bradley--Terry (BT) model is the predominant approach, modeling preference probabilities as a function of latent score differences.
sentences.zh: Bradley--Terry（BT）模型是主流方法，它将偏好概率建模为潜在分数差的函数。

sentences.en: Standard practice assumes data follows this model and learns the latent scores accordingly.
sentences.zh: 标准的做法是假设数据服从该模型，并据此学习潜在分数。

sentences.en: However, real data may violate this assumption, and it remains unclear what BT learning recovers in such cases.
sentences.zh: 然而，真实数据可能违背这一假设，在这种情况下 BT 学习究竟恢复了什么，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Starting from triplet comparison data, we formalize the preference information it encodes through the conditional preference distribution (CPRD).
sentences.zh: 从三元组比较数据出发，我们通过条件偏好分布（conditional preference distribution，CPRD）将其编码的偏好信息形式化。

sentences.en: We give precise conditions for when BT is appropriate for modeling the CPRD, and identify factors governing sample efficiency---namely, margin and connectivity.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了 BT 何时适用于对 CPRD 建模的精确条件，并确定了决定样本效率的因素——即间隔（margin）与连通性（connectivity）。

sentences.en: Together, these results offer a data-centric foundation for understanding what preference learning actually recovers.
sentences.zh: 总之，这些结果为理解偏好学习实际上恢复了什么提供了以数据为中心的坚实基础。

title_en: What Does Thompson Sampling Optimize?
title_zh: 汤普森采样优化的是什么？

sentences.en: Thompson Sampling is one of the most widely used and studied bandit algorithms, known for its simple structure, low regret performance, and solid theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 汤普森采样（Thompson Sampling）是使用最广泛、研究最多的赌徒机（bandit）算法之一，以其结构简单、遗憾（regret）低以及坚实的理论保证而著称。

sentences.en: Yet, in stark contrast to most other families of bandit algorithms, the exact mechanism through which  posterior sampling (as introduced by Thompson) is able to "properly" balance exploration and exploitation, remains a mystery.
sentences.zh: 然而，与绝大多数其他赌徒机算法家族形成鲜明对比的是，后验采样（由 Thompson 提出）究竟通过何种确切机制来“恰当”地平衡探索与利用，至今仍是一个谜。

sentences.en: In this paper, we show that the core insight to address this question stems from recasting Thompson Sampling as an online optimization algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们表明，回答这一问题的核心洞见在于将汤普森采样重新表述为一个在线优化算法。

sentences.en: To distill this, we introduce a time invariant notion of regret that summarizes cumulative regret across horizons (through a regret bound), leading to a time invariant Bellman-optimal policy.
sentences.zh: 为提炼这一洞见，我们引入了一种时间不变（time-invariant）的遗憾概念，通过一个遗憾界来概括各时间视界上的累积遗憾，从而得到一种时间不变的 Bellman 最优策略。

sentences.en: It turns out that Thompson Sampling admits an online optimization form that mimics the structure of the Bellman-optimal policy, where greediness is regularized by a measure of residual uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，汤普森采样具有一种在线优化的形式，它模仿了 Bellman 最优策略的结构，其中贪婪性由残差不确定性的一种度量来正则化。

sentences.en: When viewed through this new lens of online optimization, Thompson Sampling can be understood and improved in a principled manner, by comparing it against the Bellman-optimal benchmark.
sentences.zh: 当我们通过在线优化这一新视角来审视时，通过与 Bellman 最优基准进行比较，汤普森采样可以被以有原则的方式理解并改进。

title_en: What Does Vision Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Really Learn? Disentangling Tool-Induced and Intrinsic Effects for Crop-and-Zoom
title_zh: 视觉工具使用强化学习究竟学到什么？解析裁剪与缩放（Crop-and-Zoom）中工具引发效应与内在效应

sentences.en: Vision tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) can equip vision--language models with visual operators such as crop-and-zoom and achieves strong performance gains, yet it remains unclear whether these gains are driven by improvements in tool use or evolving intrinsic capabilities.
sentences.zh: 视觉工具使用强化学习（RL）可以为视觉-语言模型配备诸如裁剪与缩放（crop-and-zoom）之类的视觉算子，并带来显著的性能提升，但这些提升究竟源于工具使用能力的改进，还是不断演化的内在能力，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{MED} (Measure--Explain--Diagnose), a coarse-to-fine framework that disentangles intrinsic capability changes from tool-induced effects, decomposes the tool-induced performance difference into gain and harm terms, and probes the mechanisms driving their evolution.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 \textbf{MED}（Measure--Explain--Diagnose，度量-解释-诊断），一个由粗到细的框架，它将内在能力的变化与工具引发效应区分开，把工具引发的性能差异分解为增益项和损害项，并探究驱动其演化的机制。

sentences.en: Across checkpoint-level analyses on two VLMs with different tool priors and six benchmarks, we find that improvements are dominated by intrinsic learning, while tool-use RL mainly reduces tool-induced harm (e.g., fewer call-induced errors and weaker tool schema interference) and yields limited progress in tool-based correction of intrinsic failures.
sentences.zh: 在针对两个具有不同工具先验的 VLM 六个基准上进行的检查点级分析中，我们发现改进主要由内在学习驱动，而工具使用 RL 主要减少了工具引发的损害（例如，更少的由调用引发的错误、更弱的工具模式干扰），并且基于工具对内在失败进行修正的进展有限。

sentences.en: Overall, current vision tool-use RL learns to coexist safely with tools rather than master them.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，当前的视觉工具使用 RL 学会的是与工具安全地共存，而非熟练地掌握工具。

title_en: What if Tomorrow is the World Cup Final? Counterfactual Time Series Forecasting with Textual Conditions
title_zh: 如果明天是世界杯决赛会怎样？带文本条件的反事实时间序列预测

sentences.en: Time series forecasting has become increasingly critical in real-world scenarios, where future sequences are influenced not only by historical patterns but also by forthcoming events.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测在现实场景中变得越来越关键，在这些场景中，未来的序列不仅受历史模式的影响，还受即将发生的事件的影响。

sentences.en: In this context, forecasting must dynamically adapt to complex and stochastic future conditions, which introduces fundamental challenges in both forecasting and evaluation.
sentences.zh: 在这种背景下，预测必须动态地适应复杂且随机的未来条件，这给预测和评估都带来了根本性的挑战。

sentences.en: Traditional methods typically rely on historical data or factual future conditions, while overlooking counterfactual scenarios.
sentences.zh: 传统方法通常依赖历史数据或事实性的未来条件，却忽视了反事实场景。

sentences.en: Furthermore, many existing approaches are restricted to simple structured conditions, limiting their ability to generalize to the real-world complexities.
sentences.zh: 此外，许多现有方法局限于简单的结构化条件，这限制了它们向现实世界复杂情况泛化的能力。

sentences.en: To address these gaps, we introduce the task of counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, enabling more flexible and condition-aware forecasting.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这些空白，我们引入了带文本条件的反事实时间序列预测任务，从而实现更灵活、更感知条件的预测。

sentences.en: We propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that encompasses both factual and counterfactual settings, even in the absence of ground truth time series.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个全面的评估框架，涵盖事实性与反事实两种设定，即使在缺乏真实（ground truth）时间序列的情况下也能进行评估。

sentences.en: Additionally, we present a novel text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors, thereby improving forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一种新颖的文本归因机制，用于区分可变的与不可变的因素，从而在复杂且随机的文本条件下提高预测准确率。

title_en: What If We Allocate Test-Time Compute Adaptively?
title_zh: 如果我们自适应地分配测试时计算会怎样？

sentences.en: Test-time compute scaling allocates inference computation uniformly, uses fixed sampling strategies, and applies verification only for reranking.
sentences.zh: 测试时计算扩展（test-time compute scaling）会均匀地分配推理计算，使用固定的采样策略，并且只在重排（reranking）时应用验证。

sentences.en: In contrast, we propose a verifier-guided adaptive framework treating reasoning as iterative trajectory generation and selection.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们提出了一种由验证器引导的自适应框架，将推理视为迭代式的轨迹生成与选择。

sentences.en: For each problem, the agent runs multiple inference iterations.
sentences.zh: 对于每个问题，智能体都会运行多次推理迭代。

sentences.en: In each iteration, it optionally produces a high-level plan, selects a set of reasoning tools and a compute strategy together with an exploration parameter, and then generates a candidate reasoning trajectory.
sentences.zh: 在每次迭代中，它可以选择性地生成一个高层计划，选取一组推理工具、一种计算策略以及一个探索参数，然后生成一条候选推理轨迹。

sentences.en: A process reward model (PRM) serves as a unified control signal: within each iteration, step-level PRM scores are aggregated to guide pruning and expansion during generation, and across iterations, aggregated trajectory rewards are used to select the final response.
sentences.zh: 过程奖励模型（process reward model，PRM）充当统一的控制信号：在单次迭代内部，聚合逐步的 PRM 分数以指导生成过程中的剪枝与扩展；在多次迭代之间，聚合的轨迹奖励用于选择最终回答。

sentences.en: Across datasets, our dynamic, PRM-guided approach consistently outperforms direct test-time scaling, yielding large gains on MATH-500 and several-fold improvements on harder benchmarks such as AIME24 and AMO-Bench.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集上，我们这种动态的、PRM 引导的方法始终优于直接的测试时扩展方法，在 MATH-500 上取得了很大的提升，在 AIME24 和 AMO-Bench 等更具挑战性的基准上实现了数倍的改进。

sentences.en: We characterize efficiency using theoretical FLOPs and a compute intensity metric penalizing wasted generation and tool overhead, demonstrating that verification-guided allocation concentrates computation on high-utility reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 我们使用理论 FLOPs 和一种对浪费的生成及工具开销进行惩罚的计算强度指标来刻画效率，证明由验证引导的分配会将计算集中到高价值的推理路径上。

title_en: What If We Let Forecasting Forget? A Sparse Bottleneck for Cross-Variable Dependencies
title_zh: 如果让预测学会遗忘会怎样？用于跨变量依赖的稀疏瓶颈

sentences.en: Multivariate time series forecasting is critical in many real-world systems, and thus modeling cross-channel dependencies is essential.
sentences.zh: 多元时间序列预测在众多现实系统中至关重要，因此对跨通道依赖进行建模是必不可少的。

sentences.en: Although existing methods improve overall accuracy by enhancing representations and cross-channel interactions, it remains challenging to reliably capture inter-variable dependencies under specific conditions.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有方法通过增强表示和跨通道交互来提升整体准确率，但在特定条件下可靠地捕捉变量间依赖仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: We observe that dependencies in real data are often state-dependent and noisy; in such cases, dense interactions can amplify spurious correlations and lead to representation over-smoothing, which may yield unreliable predictions in certain scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，真实数据中的依赖通常具有状态依赖且带有噪声；在这种情况下，密集的交互会放大虚假相关并导致表示过度平滑，从而在特定场景下产生不可靠的预测。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose MS-FLOW, a sparse-bottleneck framework that explicitly models inter-variable interaction as capacity-limited information flow.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出了 MS-FLOW，一个稀疏瓶颈框架，它将变量间的交互显式地建模为容量受限的信息流。

sentences.en: Specifically, MS-FLOW replaces fully connected communication with selective sparse routing, retaining only a few critical dependency paths and injecting cross-variable signals under a strict communication budget, thereby suppressing redundant connections and spurious-correlation propagation.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，MS-FLOW 用选择性稀疏路由取代了全连接通信，仅保留少数关键依赖路径，并在严格的通信预算下注入跨变量信号，从而抑制冗余连接和虚假相关的传播。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that MS-FLOW learns more reliable multivariate correlations, achieving state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy on 12 real-world benchmarks while producing fewer yet more reliable dependencies, shifting multivariate forecasting from “more interaction” to “more effective interaction”.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，MS-FLOW 能够学到更可靠的多元相关关系，在 12 个真实世界基准上取得了最先进的预测准确率，同时产生更少但更可靠的依赖，将多元预测从“更多交互”推向“更有效的交互”。

title_en: What Information Matters? Graph Out-of-Distribution Detection via Tri-Component Information Decomposition
title_zh: 什么信息才是重要的？通过三组件信息分解进行图上分布外检测

sentences.en: Graph neural networks are widely used for node classification, but they remain vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts in node features and graph structure.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络被广泛应用于节点分类，但它们对节点特征和图结构中的分布外（out-of-distribution，OOD）偏移仍然很脆弱。

sentences.en: Prior work established that methods trained with standard supervised learning (SL) objectives tend to capture spurious signals from either features and/or structure, leaving the model fragile under distributional changes.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作表明，使用标准监督学习（supervised learning，SL）目标训练的方法往往会从特征和/或结构中捕捉虚假信号，从而使模型在分布变化下变得脆弱。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose TIDE, a novel and effective Tri-Component Information Decomposition framework that explicitly decomposes information into feature-specific, structure-specific and joint components.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TIDE，一个新颖且有效的三组件信息分解（Tri-Component Information Decomposition）框架，它将信息显式地分解为特征特定、结构特定和联合三个组成部分。

sentences.en: TIDE aims to preserve only the label-relevant part of the joint information while filtering out spurious feature- and structure-specific information, thereby enhancing the separation between in-distribution (ID) and OOD nodes.
sentences.zh: TIDE 旨在只保留联合信息中与标签相关的部分，同时滤除虚假的、特征特定和结构特定的信息，从而增强分布内（in-distribution，ID）节点与 OOD 节点之间的区分。

sentences.en: Beyond the framework, we provide theoretical and empirical analyses showing that an information bottleneck objective is preferable to standard SL for graph OOD detection, with higher ID confidence and a greater entropy gap between ID and OOD data.
sentences.zh: 除了框架本身，我们还提供了理论与实证分析，表明对于图上 OOD 检测，信息瓶颈（information bottleneck）目标优于标准 SL，它带来更高的 ID 置信度以及 ID 与 OOD 数据之间更大的熵差。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across seven datasets confirm the efficacy of Tide, achieving up to a 34% improvement in FPR95 over strong baselines while maintaining competitive ID accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在七个数据集上的大量实验证实了 TIDE 的有效性，与强基线相比，FPR95 最高提升了 34%，同时保持了具有竞争力的 ID 准确率。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/DannyW618/TIDE.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/DannyW618/TIDE 获取。
